method: Production WMS ledger with deterministic receiving, bin transfers, exact allocations, picking, loading and offsite shipment transactions. No Unity scene or warehouse state is changed.
scope: Domain integrity only. Physical carton movement, scanner label visibility, supported bin placement and browser controls require their separate runtime checks.

checks.name: definitions reject duplicates and invalid carton units
definition and order inputs are copied
expected delivery is not on-hand inventory
partial receipt tracks the exact purchase line
wrong PO and duplicate receipt leave stock unchanged
receiving rejects wrong, closed and full bins
expected cartons cannot exceed purchase quantities
transfer checks source, destination and capacity
transfer records the scanned route once
reserve locations require transfer before picking
short second sales line cannot reserve the first
allocation reserves oldest eligible handling units
reservations exclude stock from another sales order
duplicate release and reserved transfers reject
pick requires the correct order, carton and source
pick requires open staging with capacity
partial picking preserves exact line progress
loading requires picked stock and dispatch capacity
loading does not ship or remove on-hand stock
incomplete and split-vehicle manifests cannot ship
offsite shipment decrements stock exactly once
cancelling an unpicked order releases reservations
picked stock must be returned before cancellation
loaded stock can return through a validated bin move
only an untouched purchase order can be cancelled
bin opening is recorded and occupied bins cannot close
the next purchase and sales order repeat cleanly
transaction history retains quantities and stable sequence
100 mixed orders conserve stock and line quantities
